title: UI风格#183 - Blueprint Technical (蓝图技术)
description: 创建第183种UI风格：蓝图技术风格 - 工程蓝图美学、线条图纸、网格线。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGA.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Blueprint Technical style When color palette Then features blueprint blue, white lines, grid on dark blue
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#1E3A5F (蓝图蓝), #FFFFFF (白线), #4A90D9 (浅蓝), #0A1628 (深夜蓝), #2D5A87 (中蓝)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Blueprint Technical style When typography Then uses technical: Consolas, Courier Prime, or Share Tech Mono
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Consolas (技术), Courier Prime (等宽), Share Tech Mono (蓝图)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Blueprint Technical style When layout Then grid paper, construction lines, dimension markers, scale indicators
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：网格纸、施工线、尺寸标记、比例指示

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Blueprint Technical style When UI elements Then line draw animation, grid snap, measurement tooltips, crosshair
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：线条绘制动画、网格吸附、测量提示、十字线

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Blueprint Technical UI When functional Then includes draft chat, schematic agents, scale stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：草图聊天、原理图代理、比例统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Blueprint Technical UI When copy Then uses technical: 'Draft', 'Scale', 'Dimension', 'Draft'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'DRAFT. SCALE. DIMENSION.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'PLOT'、'DEPLOY'→'RENDER'
